-- Update manuscript with new content and reset all analysis
UPDATE manuscripts SET
  title = $2,
  genre = $3,
  current_word_count = $4,
  full_text = $5,
  manuscript_summary = NULL,
  full_analysis_key_points = NULL,
  full_analysis_text = NULL,
  report_pdf_url = NULL,
  analysis_started_at = NULL,
  full_analysis_completed_at = NULL,
  developmental_phase_completed_at = NULL,
  developmental_version = NULL,
  developmental_version_created_at = NULL,
  line_editing_started_at = NULL,
  line_editing_ready_at = NULL,
  sam_initial_thoughts = NULL,
  copy_editing_started_at = NULL,
  copy_editing_ready_at = NULL,
  jordan_initial_thoughts = NULL,
  alex_report_pdf_url = NULL,
  sam_report_pdf_url = NULL,
  jordan_report_pdf_url = NULL,
  taylor_report_pdf_url = NULL,
  quinn_report_pdf_url = NULL,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1;

SELECT 'manuscript_updated' as step;

-- Reset all phases to pending except Phase 1
UPDATE editing_phases SET
  phase_status = 'pending',
  started_at = NULL,
  completed_at = NULL,
  ai_read_started_at = NULL,
  ai_read_completed_at = NULL,
  report_pdf_url = NULL,
  chapters_analyzed = 0,
  chapters_approved = 0,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE manuscript_id = $1 AND phase_number != 1;

-- Set Phase 1 to active
UPDATE editing_phases SET
  phase_status = 'active',
  started_at = NULL,
  completed_at = NULL,
  ai_read_started_at = NULL,

  report_pdf_url = NULL,

  updated_at = NOW()
